mkdir .toolbox
mkdir tools

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/python/ok.py tools/ok.py
exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --name py-add --script ./tools/ok.py
stdout 'Created task "py-add"'
exists .toolbox/tasks/py-add.yaml
exists .toolbox/scripts/py-add.py

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run py-add
stdout 'hello from add'

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/python/alt.py tools/alt.py
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --name py-add --script ./tools/alt.py
stderr '--overwrite'
exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --name py-add --script ./tools/alt.py --overwrite
stdout 'Created task "py-add"'

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run py-add
stdout 'hello from overwrite'

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/python/ok.py tools/spec.py
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/specs/python-add.yaml add-from-spec.yaml
exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --from-spec ./add-from-spec.yaml --json
stdout '"status": "created"'
stdout '"task": "spec-task"'
stdout '"scope": "project"'
stdout '"next_command": "toolbox run spec-task"'
exists .toolbox/tasks/spec-task.yaml
exists .toolbox/scripts/spec-task.py

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --scope bundled --name bundled-task --script ./tools/ok.py
stdout 'Created task "bundled-task"'
exists tasks/bundled-task.yaml
exists scripts/bundled-task.py

exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run bundled-task
stdout 'hello from add'

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/python/bad.py tools/bad.py
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN add python --name bad-task --script ./tools/bad.py
stderr 'py_compile check failed'
! exists .toolbox/tasks/bad-task.yaml
! exists .toolbox/scripts/bad-task.py
